name: custtoolset_pillar1_extractor
description: Extracts foundational NetSuite configuration metadata, including custom field definitions and installed third-party bundles, for system auditing and architecture mapping.

extractionType.description: The specific Pillar 1 dataset to extract. Use 'custom_fields' to map standard and custom object schema, or 'bundles' to inventory third-party dependencies.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing the requested architectural metadata formatted for AI heuristic evaluation.
